name: booyah-fire
description: BOOYAH FIRE — a Free Fire–style 3D battle royale that runs in the browser with no build step. The game itself loads three.js from ./vendor/ via an importmap, and tools/build-apk.mjs packs it into an Android APK with a pure-Node signer; the 'three' devDependency below exists only so the headless Node test harnesses can import the same modules.

scripts.test:all: node tools/check-assets.mjs && node tools/check-html.mjs && node tools/check-style.mjs && node tools/check-standalone.mjs && node tools/test-sim.mjs && node tools/test-view.mjs && node tools/test-dom.mjs && node tools/test-apk-sign.mjs
